senses.gloss: --the राक्षष residing in Tatvalam (Atalam- वा। प्।). Br. II. २०. १७; वा. ५०. १७.

--(see शूलभृत् or शूलधर): a name of शिव;
1: M. १०४. १०; १४०. ४८; १५४. ३९६; Vi. V. ३३. ४५.
admitted for share in sacrifice due to fear of दण्ड;
2: M. २२५. १८.
approaches नारायण after ब्रह्मा issues from his belly; his approach is noticed by ब्रह्मा and reported to नारायण who explains his nature asking ब्रह्मा to join him in a praise of; dialogue between ब्रह्मा and नारायण on the greatness of; praise of by both; gives boons to ब्रह्मा who wants him as son or one equal to him; appreciates विष्णु and disappears.
3: वा. २४. ३६-165; २५. 1-२७.
[page३-459+ ३३]
--one of the twenty-eight hells for those who allure innocents by magical and other practices. भा. V. २६. 7 and ३२.
--a तीर्थ on the नर्मदा; sacred to शिव. M. १९१. 3-4.
(I)--the trident, held by गन्गा in worshipping शिव in Meru. वा. ३०. ९२.
(II)--a stake, mounting on; a punishment in hell. Vi. VI. 5. ४७.

--is शिव,
1: Br. IV. ११. २८; ३०. ७४.
the अवतार् of the Lord in the २४थ् dva1para in the नैमिष.
2: वा. २३. २०६.
--the kingdom of; a northern kingdom. Br. II. ३१. ८३; M. १२१. ४५; वा. ४७. ४४; ५८. ८३.
